script.text: @Innkeeper#end:touch     "Hello,would you like a room for thenight for 3 gems?"!x1;Yes,I'll take it.#end:x1#take gems 3 getout     "It's the room at the end of the hallwith the blue door."#send door:bought#put w blue key#zap touch#end:getoutYou haven't got 3 gems!#end

@Weapon maker#end:touch     "Hello.Are you interested in buyingany weapons or arrows for your bow?"!x1;10 arrows.................1 gem!x2;Sword.....................3 gems!x3;Axe.......................4 gems!x4;Spear.....................2 gems!x5;Mace......................3 gems#end:x1#take gems 1 notenuffHere you go.#give ammo 10#end:x2#take gems 3 notenuffHere's your sword.#set sword#end:x3#take gems 4 notenuffHere's your axe.#set axe#end:x4#take gems 2 notenuffHere's your spear.#set spear#end:x5#take gems 3Here's your mace.#set mace#end:notenuffYou don't have enough.#end

@Armor maker#end:touch     "Welcome.Are you in need of fine metal armor?"!x1;Chain mail...................7 gems!x2;Scale mail...................10 gems!x3;Chest plate..................15 gems#end:x1#take gems 7 notenuffHere's your chain mail shirt.#set chain#end:x2#take gems 10 notenuffHere's your scale mail shirt.#set scale#end:x3#take gems 15 notenuffHere's your steel chest plate.#set plate#end:notenuffYou don't have enough gems.#end

@intro     As you approach the little town ofDelmar,you think back to the border patrolof Baron Dammak,that confiscated all of your possessions except for your bow anda hidden pouch of 10 gems.The rule of Dammak is well known throughout the entireland as a hideous mockery of justice.Youhad dreaded coming into this land,but to go around it would take weeks.The town isdoing fairly well,but all the people aregloomy and scared.Perhaps things in thebarony of Dammak's are worse than rumorsrelated them!#give gems 10#die
@hints#end:hintWhy not visit the local tavern?#end

@Leather worker#end:touch     "Hello.Would you care to purchase anyfine leatherwork?"!x1;Boots......................1 gem!x2;Belt.......................1 gem!x3;Shirt......................2 gems#end:x1#take gems 1 notenuffHere you are,one pair of boots.#set boots#end:x2#take gems 1 notenuffOne fine leather belt,coming up.#set belt#end:x3#take gems 2 notenuffHere you go,a shirt of fine leather.#set shirt#end:notenuffYou don't have enough gems.#end
SORRY,CLOSED!Due to overtaxation,the food and supply store has been closed down.Sorry.                -Proprieter,                  Elwin Sneed

@Barkeep#end:touch     "Here you go.Have a mug of ale on thehouse.I'm three weeks delinquent on my taxes,so I'll be arrested soon anyway.Nota chance of me making the 150 gems in thenext couple days,so I'm not worried aboutmaking any money."     You take the cold mug of ale and sipon it as you walk away,contemplating theman's sad situation.#zap touch#end
@Box#end:touchHmmm..An old firewood box.It is still laden with small branches that would makeperfect torches.You take the torches.#give torches 20#zap touch#end

@Broadsword#end:touch     The owner of this fine weapon appearsto have left it behind.No sense in lettingit sit here,when you could use it.You takethe broadsword with you.#set broadsword#give score 50#die

@Ewal The Prophet#end:touch     Well! You never expected to come faceto face with Ewal The Prophet!In all thetales of yore,Ewal plays a major role.He counseled Sir Jeremy when he marched against the armies of Nadilia.He was saidto have accompanied Lord Thenuul when herecovered the Sun Stone from the lands ofevil.Ewal's name is known all across the land,and here he is,sitting in a bar in the derelict town of Delmar!     "Hello,son.Been waiting for you forquite some time now.Aye,it's you I've beenwaiting for.Surely you don't think that you'd have vanquished the ghost of KingLucius without the gods knowing?Oh yes,andthe gods told me.And I know about your future,my boy..I can see that you've donesomething that will cause you great pain in the coming days..But,had you not done it,you would never have reached your goal.I am here to tell you what you must do toremedy your predicament."$What predicament is this??     "Heh,heh..Boy,you've unleashed thepower of light with an evil bent,and it'sout to kill you.I can't tell you the wholestory,but I CAN tell you that what you must find is in Dammak's castle.Yes,thathorrid place.And I can assure you thatyou'll risk your life many times beforeyou get to even the first part of yourjourney."$So what should I do?     "First things first:go get yourselfa room at the Inn..You'll need a place tostay..Then you'll want to buy yourself some equipment.There's a wall north of thetown that blocks off the main road.Get past the gate guard any way you can.From there on,you're pretty much on your own."$On my own? But where should I go??     "Don't worry,the gods will see to itthat you don't go too far off the path.One thing I can tell you now is:when youcome to the foothills,be sure that you arenot being followed by the gaze of the Watcher in the tower..Good luck,my son!"#give score 1000#zap touch#end:touch     "I see you have returned..I can't help you any more right now..We shall meetagain,though..I assure you of that!"#end

@Gaurd#if alligned then message#end:message     "Hey,no one is permitted beyond thispoint!Go back to the town or I'll have touse force!"#end:touch#if sword then hit2#if axe then hit2#if mace then hit3#if spear then hit4#if broadsword then hit5:hit1You punch the guard,but he counters witha slash from his sword!#take energy 50#end:hit2You slice the guard and he falls to theground,dead.On his body you find 10 gemsand a Cyan Key.#give gems 10#put south cyan key#die:hit3You club at the gaurd!#zap hit3#end:hit3You hit the gaurd again,and he falls!You find 10 gems and a Cyan Key on his corpse!#give gems 10#put s cyan key#die:hit4The spear is too awkward to attack thegaurd with,and he blocks your attack andcounters with a blow from his sword!#take energy 50#end:hit5You bring the Broadsword down on his neckand the gaurd crumples.His severed headbounces off into a ditch.On his body youfind a Cyan Key and 10 gems.#give gems 10#put s cyan key#die:shot:shot:shotYour arrow pierces the guard's armor,and he responds by hurling a knife at you!#shoot seek#zap shot:shotThe guard falls to the gound dead.You finda Cyan Key and 10 gems on his body.#give gems 10#put s cyan key#die

@Flooded trail/i/i/i/i/i     The path leading eastward has beenflooded by the seasonal swelling of theBhakades river that runs thru the marsh.Besides an unclear trail running northwardalong the riverbank,you cannot continue.#end

@Swamp Temple/i/i/i/i     You hack your way along the path andfinally see its destination.A vine-coveredganite structure has been erected in a small gap in the dense foliage.You havenever seen a structure like this in all ofyour travels,and are certain that it was not made by human hands./i/i/i/i     As you draw closer,you notice the intricate carvings that adorn the buildingand decide that it must be a temple ofsome sort.Noxious vapors wafting from theswampy patches of land remind you that nohuman would live here.This thought makesthe hair on your neck stand up and youcontemplate the wisdom of investigatingthis temple any further.#end
@Quiver#end:touchYou find a quiver of 100 arrows!#give ammo 100#die

@temple/i/i/i/i/i     Hmm...Two giant statues of strangelizards,covered with Lapis Lazulai andSapphire chips pose on either side of atiny turqoise building.Its entrance isobscured by a mechanical door that onlyallows things to pass out of it.Perhapsthe entrance is elsewhere...#end

@Watcher#end:touch#if blinded then passYou have been seen by the Watchtower!!Hordes of enemy soldiers and ferociousbeasts FLOCK out of the foothills!You areoverwhelmed in a tide of death!#endgame:pass#die

@Warrior#set full#end:touchBefore you stands the guardian of thewatchtower.You can make out his monstrousphysique through the red-painted chainmail he wears.!x1;Attack warrior#end:x1The Warrior brings down his sword in anarcing slash which strikes your shoulder!#if chain then hurt1#if scale then hurt2#if plate then hurt3The blow DEVASTATES you! You fall to thefloor in a crumpled, bleeding heap!#endgame:hurt1His sword injurs you heavily!#take health 10/i#send attack:hurt2His sword does slight damage!#take health 7/i#send attack:hurt3You are merely grazed!#take health 5/i#send attack:attack#if spear then hit1#if sword then hit2#if mace then hit3#if axe then hit4#if broadsword then hit5You club at him with your fist,but his armor merely bruises your hand!!#send x1 :hit1You ram your spear into his gut!#send dam1:hit2Your sword slashes him violently!#send dam1:hit3You smash at him with your mace!#send dam2:hit4Your axe cleaves him down the middle!!#give score 100#die:hit5Your mighty broadsword skewers the knight!#give score 100#die:dam1#if full then dam1b#if half then dam1c#give score 100#die:dam2#if full then dam2b#give score 100#die:dam1b#clear full#set half#send x1:dam1c#clear half#send x1:dam2b#clear full#send x1

@Castle/i/i/iThe Foothills rise to small peaks on allsides of you,now.Over the rising landscapeyou can make out the towers of the Keep ofDammak.The ground is sooty black and poolsof molten rock are visible on the edges ofthe path.This is obviously quite the placeto build a stronghold.Suddenly you hear the shrieks of hideous, sub-human things!The abominable gaurdians of the keep are charging forth from the surrounding hills!#end

@Arch of Destiny#end:touch     This is the fabled arch of Amuran!At one time this blue,crystal archway wasthe entrance to the golden city of Amuran.Since the destruction of the city(the citywas devastated by the gods because of itscitizen's excessive pride),the gate has passed through many hands.It was said tobe all that remained of the golden city,and was thus considered very valuable.Itdarkens your heart to think that this holyartifact should be enshrined in such an evil place.#end

@Ferryman#end:touchThe robed ferryman holds out his gloved palm as if awaiting payment for passage.#if coin then do#end:doA voice from beyond the grave echoes fromunder the ferryman's hood.$You may now cross,oh seeker.#change water fake#die

@Subterranian River/i/iThe sound of splashing tide comes to yourears.You pause and listen closely.Yes!It is indeed the sound of the ocean!But,howis that sound reaching you here?You aremany miles from the sea and deep under-ground...#end

@Coin#end:touch     The coin has been placed here so thatusers can see the throne room to the northin this Beta version.In the final version,you will have to complete the three trialsin the room south of here before the boxwill open and you can get the coin.#set coin#die
@Candle#end:touchLet the truth of love be lighted!#die
@Bell#end:touchSensibility armed with Sense and Liberty!#die
@Book#end:touchLet the love of truth shine clear!#die
Here lies the Book of Truth.Tread within these passages cautiously,forfalsehood will seek always to lead youastray! Find your path wisely!
Here lies the Candle of Love.Let not dark thoughts burden your mind andyou shall pass these tunnels with ease.
Here lies the Bell of Courage.Hold thine head aloft and fight with thestrength of twenty men.This passage willyield its secrets not to cowards!

@Knight of No Color#end:touch     "I am the Knight of No Color.I poseno threat to you,and you none to me.I am here only to warn.There are three Knightsof Color.They were produced when King Lucius's spirit was vanquished and his tower of Spectral Energy was destroyed.King Lucius was once the guardian of lightand energy,but the evil power of the threecolored knights corrupted his soul and brought about his death.His ghost lived onfor many years,until recently.You are theone that slew his evil puppet-spirit.Thusyou are blessed and cursed by your doings.You have unleashed the three Knights of Color,and they seek to destroy you.I knowthat one of them guards the Watcher in thetower,and I sense that he has been slainby your hand.It is good that you have beaten The Red Knight,but know that hisbrothers will not be so weak!May we meetagain,oh killer of light!"#give score 1000#die

@Box#end:touch#if book then check 2:messageThere is a golden box with a transparent lid resting on the ground.Inside the boxlies a golden coin the size of your palm.The box's lid appears to have no hinges orlatch of any sort,and you cannot break itopen no matter how hard you try.#end:check2#if candle then check3#send message:check3#if bell then open#send message:openThe golden box's lid peels back of its ownaccord,revealing the golden coin!#char 007#zap touch#end:touchYou pluck the golden coin from the ground#set coin#die
